lg.$description: Space between icon and label in large controls. Pairs with control.icon.lg.

md.$description: Space between icon and label in default controls. Pairs with control.icon.md.

sm.$description: Space between icon and label in small controls. Pairs with control.icon.sm.

xs.$description: Space between icon and label in the smallest controls. Pairs with control.icon.xs.

lg.$description: Fixed height for large controls. Pairs with typography.control.lg and control.padding-x.lg.

md.$description: Fixed height for default controls. Pairs with typography.control.md and control.padding-x.md.

sm.$description: Fixed height for small controls. Pairs with typography.control.sm and control.padding-x.sm.

xs.$description: Fixed height for the smallest controls and dense rows. Pairs with control.padding-x.xs.

lg.$description: Icon size inside large controls. Pairs with control.height.lg.

md.$description: Icon size inside default controls. Pairs with control.height.md.

sm.$description: Icon size inside small controls. Pairs with control.height.sm.

xs.$description: Icon size inside the smallest controls. Pairs with control.height.xs.

inset.$description: Inset between a control boundary and nested content such as segments. Pairs with control.height.

lg.$description: Horizontal padding on the side of large controls that holds an icon beside a label. It is control.padding-x.lg less a small optical trim, so the icon side does not look wider than the text side. Alias it to control.padding-x.lg for symmetric padding.

md.$description: Horizontal padding on the side of default controls that holds an icon beside a label. It is control.padding-x.md less a small optical trim, so the icon side does not look wider than the text side. Alias it to control.padding-x.md for symmetric padding.

sm.$description: Horizontal padding on the side of small controls that holds an icon beside a label. It is control.padding-x.sm less a small optical trim, so the icon side does not look wider than the text side. Alias it to control.padding-x.sm for symmetric padding.

xs.$description: Horizontal padding on the side of the smallest controls that holds an icon beside a label. It is control.padding-x.xs less a small optical trim, so the icon side does not look wider than the text side. Alias it to control.padding-x.xs for symmetric padding.

lg.$description: Horizontal padding for large controls. Pairs with control.height.lg.

md.$description: Horizontal padding for default controls. Pairs with control.height.md.

sm.$description: Horizontal padding for small controls. Pairs with control.height.sm.

xs.$description: Horizontal padding for the smallest controls. Pairs with control.height.xs.

min.$description: Minimum touch target for any control. Pairs with control.height tokens via padding or hit areas.

100.$description: Tightest standard gap, between closely related elements such as an icon and its label.

150.$description: Small gap inside compact controls and tags. Pairs with control.gap.sm.

200.$description: Default small gap between related items, and small control padding.

250.$description: Between-small-and-medium gap for compact lists and form rows.

300.$description: Default medium gap and padding for content containers, groups and default controls.

350.$description: Medium-plus gap, and icon size in extra-small controls.

400.$description: Standard section gap and content container padding, and icon size in small controls.

450.$description: Icon size in default controls, and generous inner padding.

500.$description: Large inner padding, and icon size and padding in large controls.

550.$description: Large gap between groups of related content.

600.$description: Large gap between components within a section.

650.$description: Large-plus gap for spacious component layouts.

700.$description: Section-level gap for separating content blocks.

750.$description: Generous section gap on roomy layouts.

800.$description: Large section gap and page-level padding.

850.$description: Extra-large section gap between page regions.

900.$description: Very large gap between major page regions.

950.$description: Last half-base step (base × 9.5), for wide gaps between page regions.

1000.$description: Base × 10. From here each step adds a whole base, not half.

2000.$description: Largest step in the scale (base × 30), for hero and page-level separation.

000.$description: No space. Use to reset a gap or padding to zero.

050.$description: Hairline gap for tightly packed inner elements. Pairs with control.inset.
